rule:
The height of a riser must not be more than 175 mm.

Regulatory text (the authoritative clause - use it to interpret the requirement; you must still work out how to read it out of the IFC):
BCA Approved Document (Acceptable Solutions V7.08) - E.3.4 Risers and treads:
E.3.4.1 The height of a riser shall not be more than 175 mm. (see Figure E.3.4.2(a) for measurement of “riser”)

The riser height is the vertical rise of one step of a stair flight. A flight whose riser height is not recorded anywhere in the model cannot be judged: label it ALERT, and do NOT report it as a violation.

Report the GlobalId of every element (modelled as IfcStairFlight) that does NOT satisfy this requirement.
